lines.text: Many learners say: My uncle lives at a small town.
Better: My uncle lives in a small town.
In! We live in a big city.

data.wrong: My uncle lives at a small town.
data.right: My uncle lives in a small town.

native.tip: Kita bilang “tinggal di kota”, dan sering mengira “di” selalu at. Untuk kota, pakai in.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “My uncle lives at a small town.” 😅 Untuk kota, pakai in: “My uncle lives in a small town.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “in”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I live in a big city.” Lalu ganti dengan kotamu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “tinggal di kota”, and often think “di” is always at. For a town or city, use in.
en.caption: Ever say this? “My uncle lives at a small town.” 😅 For a town or city, use in: “My uncle lives in a small town.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
